<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1242
Claimant:
John Hernandez
Adjuster:
Chelsea Hebert
09/20/2024
First notice of loss received for a side impact at an intersection involving the insured's vehicle and a second vehicle.
The claimant reports neck strain and is represented by counsel, so all further contact will be routed through the
attorney's office.
09/23/2024
Confirmed the driver is named on the policy and that coverage was in force on the date of loss. No issues with the
policy have been identified.
10/03/2024
Obtained the police report, which places the claimant in the vehicle at the time of the collision. Independent
confirmation of occupancy has been received.
11/08/2024
Reviewed the photographs submitted with the claim. They confirm several details of the impact, though no
independent witnesses have come forward to describe the collision itself.
11/09/2024
Spoke with the claimant, who described the crash consistently with the account given at first notice. The same
account was repeated in every conversation so far.
12/04/2024
Inspected the vehicle damage. The damage is mostly consistent with the described impact pattern and the point of
contact on the side of the vehicle.
01/26/2025
Searched prior claim records and inspected the vehicle for signs of earlier repairs. No earlier damage to the vehicle is
known, and nothing suggests the damage predates the policy start.
01/30/2025
Received the medical summary from the treating provider. The reported neck strain is a plausible injury for a collision
of this type.
01/31/2025
Reviewed the claimant's medical history as disclosed. A small strain in the same area was documented years ago
and resolved fully with no ongoing complaints.
02/04/2025
Treatment has continued somewhat longer than is typical for a neck strain of this kind. Requested updated records
and a current treatment plan from the provider through counsel.
02/09/2025
Discussed the file with the supervisor. The injury and vehicle damage findings are consistent with the loss as
reported, and the remaining review is focused on the length of treatment.
02/20/2025
Sent a status letter to claimant's counsel listing outstanding medical records and requesting the treatment timeline.
File remains open pending receipt.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
